hooks.command: f=$(uv run --no-project python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) uvx ruff@0.15.13 format "$f"; uvx ruff@0.15.13 check --fix "$f";; esac; true
